\section{Method}

\subsection{Setup}

We replay 10.5 GB of captured traffic through each classifier at a fixed rate of 120 ms
per batch. The offered load is swept from 10\% to 95\% in steps of 5\%.

The score is the macro-averaged F1 defined in Eq. 1:

\begin{equation}
  F_1 = 2 \cdot \frac{p \cdot r}{p + r}
  \label{eq:f1}
\end{equation}

Table~\ref{tab:results} reports the sweep, and Figure~\ref{fig:load} plots it.

\begin{table}[t]
  \centering
  \begin{tabular}{lrr}
    \toprule
    Classifier & F1 & Load \\
    \midrule
    Baseline & 94.32 & 30\% \\
    Ours & 90.11 & 95\% \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
  \caption{Sweep results at each offered load.}
  \label{tab:results}
\end{table}

\begin{figure}[t]
  \includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/load.pdf}
  \caption{F1 against offered load.}
  \label{fig:load}
\end{figure}
